author.description: The ID of the user object, if author was a user.

author_email.description: Email address for the comment author.

author_ip.description: IP address for the comment author.

author_name.description: Display name for the comment author.

author_user_agent.description: User agent for the comment author.

raw.description: Content for the comment, as it exists in the database.

rendered.description: HTML content for the comment, transformed for display.

date.description: The date the comment was published, in the site's timezone.

date_gmt.description: The date the comment was published, as GMT.

parent.description: The ID for the parent of the comment.

post.description: The ID of the associated post object.

author_avatar_urls.description: Avatar URLs for the comment author.

24.description: Avatar URL with image size of 24 pixels.

48.description: Avatar URL with image size of 48 pixels.

96.description: Avatar URL with image size of 96 pixels.
